summary: Returns the value after checking that it is not a symbol.
description: Registered symbols from `Symbol.for` and the well-known symbols both pass; nothing else does.
`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

params.message: The message of the exception. A default is used when omitted.
params.strict: When `true`, a string counts as empty only if it has no characters at all; by default whitespace is trimmed first.

returns: the same value, with a symbol excluded from its type.

examples.title: What passes and what does not
examples.body:
```javascript
requireNonSymbol("id"); // => "id"
requireNonSymbol(null); // => null
requireNonSymbol(Symbol("id")); // throws IllegalArgumentException
requireNonSymbol(Symbol.iterator); // throws IllegalArgumentException
```
